_comment: Source spec for the Hanyu Library. Every text here is in the PUBLIC DOMAIN.
The bar is life + 70 years, so the library is clear for worldwide App Store
distribution rather than only in life+50 territories. `pdBasis` records why
each book qualifies; `sourceNote` records where the text came from.
Deliberately EXCLUDED: the erotic classics carried by the same sources
(金瓶梅, 肉蒲團 and the 禁書 series) — wrong fit for the App Store age rating.
as nested lists, matched in SOURCE order not spec order), or 'auto'.
expectChapters is a QA assertion only — it never changes the output.

books.title: 呐喊
books.author: 鲁迅
books.blurb: The collection that founded modern Chinese fiction. Early vernacular 白话 — the first classic you can actually read without translating from Classical Chinese.
books.pdBasis: Lu Xun died 1936; public domain under life+70 since 2007.
books._note: This source edition omits the preface and 頭髮的故事; 13 pieces are present.

books.title: 朝花夕拾
books.author: 鲁迅
books.blurb: Lu Xun's childhood memoirs — warmer and gentler than his fiction, and some of the most approachable prose of the era.
books.pdBasis: Lu Xun died 1936; public domain under life+70 since 2007.
books._note: This source edition carries 8 of the 12 essays; the other four are absent from it entirely.

books.title: 沉沦
books.author: 郁达夫
books.blurb: A landmark of confessional modern fiction, written in plain vernacular Chinese.
books.pdBasis: Yu Dafu died 1945; public domain under life+70 since 2016.

books.title: 欧游杂记
books.author: 朱自清
books.blurb: Travel essays by a master of clear, unfussy modern prose — widely used in Chinese schools as a model of good writing.
books.pdBasis: Zhu Ziqing died 1948; public domain under life+70 since 2019.

books.title: 唐诗三百首
books.author: 蘅塘退士 编
books.blurb: The verses every Chinese child learns by heart. Short, famous and endlessly quotable — the friendliest way into classical Chinese.
books.pdBasis: Compiled 1763; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 诗经
books.author: 佚名
books.blurb: The oldest anthology of Chinese poetry and one of the Five Classics — folk songs, court hymns and ritual odes.
books.pdBasis: Ancient text; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 李太白集
books.author: 李白
books.blurb: China's most beloved poet, in full. Moonlight, wine, exile and the road home.
books.pdBasis: Li Bai died 762; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 论语
books.author: 孔子及弟子
books.blurb: The sayings of Confucius, in twenty books. Classical Chinese — read it with the parallel translation alongside.
books.pdBasis: Ancient text; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 道德经
books.author: 老子
books.blurb: Eighty-one short chapters, the foundation of Taoism. Each one is a few lines long — ideal for reading a chapter a day.
books.pdBasis: Ancient text; long out of copyright worldwide.
books.chapterRegex: ^第[一二三四五六七八九十百]+章

books.title: 孙子兵法
books.author: 孙武
books.blurb: Thirteen chapters on strategy — the most quoted Chinese book in the world, and short enough to finish.
books.pdBasis: Ancient text; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 孟子
books.author: 孟子
books.blurb: The second great Confucian text, and a far livelier read than the Analects — Mencius argues, needles and tells stories.
books.pdBasis: Ancient text; long out of copyright worldwide.
books._note: This source edition is a continuous stream with no book/chapter headings, so it is split into even reading sections rather than mislabelled as the traditional seven books.

books.title: 聊斋志异
books.titleEnglish: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio
books.author: 蒲松龄
books.blurb: Ghost stories, fox spirits and scholars who fall in love with the wrong things. Hundreds of very short tales — dip in anywhere.
books.pdBasis: Pu Songling died 1715; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 古文观止
books.author: 吴楚材、吴调侯 编
books.authorEnglish: compiled by Wu Chucai and Wu Diaohou
books.blurb: The standard anthology of classical prose for three centuries — the essays educated Chinese readers were expected to know.
books.pdBasis: Compiled 1695; long out of copyright worldwide.

books.title: 三字经
books.author: 王应麟
books.blurb: The classic children's primer: the whole of Confucian learning in rhyming three-character lines. Short, rhythmic and made to be memorised.
books.pdBasis: 13th-century text; long out of copyright worldwide.
books._note: Correctly a single continuous text — it is one unbroken rhyming primer, not a chaptered work.
